Method of Attack: Remote code execution (RCE) exploiting CVE-2022-47966 vulnerability in Zoho ManageEngine products
Use of PowerShell scripts to disable Microsoft Defender real-time protection and add exclusions
Deployment of remote access tools camouflaged as Windows Service Host service
Use of Golang protocol tunneling tool named Chisel to create reverse ssh tunnel
Downloading and executing files via curl from remote server
Impacted Systems: Zoho ManageEngine products (at least 24 on-premise products including ServiceDesk Plus and Endpoint Central)
Microsoft Defender on compromised Windows systems
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unauthenticated pre-authentication RCE vulnerability CVE-2022-47966
Internet-exposed ManageEngine instances with SAML SSO enabled
Indicators of Compromise: IP addresses including 221.226.159.22 (China Telecom Backbone) and 106.246.224.219
Publicly available exploit code for CVE-2022-47966
PowerShell scripts disabling Defender and adding exclusions
